name: Vansen Utility Work Shirt — Long Sleeve
description: Long-sleeve work shirt in washed slate-blue polycotton with a chest name-badge panel and two button-flap breast pockets. Vansen Augmented Labor Solutions logo embroidered on the right shoulder in white thread. The fabric is thick enough to resist minor sparks but soft enough to wear for a twelve-hour shift.
functionality: Elbow reinforcement panels, a ventilated back yoke for heat management, and a cable-routing channel along the left sleeve for aug power feeds.
what_it_says: You show up, you do the job, and the company name on your shoulder tells everyone whose time you belong to.
story_hooks: The cable channel on the sleeve is a non-standard feature — someone inside Vansen's supply chain added it without official approval.
Workers at two competing facilities wear nearly identical shirts from the same manufacturer — a quiet reminder that both corponations source from the same place.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian work shirt with a straight, no-nonsense cut. The washed slate-blue gives it a lived-in, industrial appearance despite its corporate origin. The chest name-badge panel and embroidered Vansen logo mark the wearer as officially sanctioned labor—corpo-adjacent but floor-level. Medium weight, designed for function over fashion.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the torso and shoulders, allowing freedom of movement for manual work and augmentation compatibility. Sleeves are straight and uncluttered, tapering slightly at the wrist for glove compatibility. Designed for layering over subcutaneous tech or under reinforced vests.
physical_description.primary_material: Washed polycotton blend with spark-resistant synthetic fibers woven through. The weave is tight enough to resist minor thermal events but breathable for extended wear.
physical_description.texture: Soft with a subtle diagonal twill pattern. The wash gives it a slightly faded, broken-in appearance even when new. Feels substantial in hand—industrial-grade comfort.
physical_description.color_scheme: Washed slate-blue with white thread embroidery. The fading is uneven, suggesting authentic wear patterns rather than artificial distressing. No other accent colors.
physical_description.closures: Seven white plastic buttons down the front placket. Button-flap design on two chest pockets for secure tool or data-chip storage.
distinctive_features: Embroidered Vansen Augmented Labor Solutions logo on right shoulder in white thread
Two button-flap breast pockets sized for standard work tools or data modules
Reinforced stitching at stress points (shoulders, underarms, pocket corners)
Spark-resistant synthetic weave for workshop/industrial environment safety
Subtle wear fading across shoulders and cuffs from repeated use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3—working class. This is corporate-issued, meaning the wearer has stable employment with a recognized megacorp. Not luxury, but legitimately employed.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this marks you as Vansen labor—augmented or augmentation-ready. You're part of the regulated workforce, not a street operator or independent. The badge panel suggests you're trackable, accountable, and integrated into corporate infrastructure.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and functional. Minor fading at stress points, clean but showing honest wear. Buttons may be slightly discolored from repeated handling. The fabric holds its shape well despite being laundered frequently.

image_prompt: Neo-noir fashion photography of a Vansen Utility Work Shirt on a lean augmented model with visible subcutaneous tech traces along the neck and wrists. Shot from waist-up against a dark industrial backdrop—corrugated metal wall with faint neon cyan accent lighting. The shirt's washed slate-blue fabric catches sidelight, emphasizing the worn twill texture. The Vansen logo on the shoulder glows subtly under studio lights. Model wears neutral expression, one hand resting on sternum over the name-badge panel. Moody, overcast lighting. Shot in the style of corporate labor documentation meets high fashion. --ar 2:3 --v 6
